subject.title: [Bug]: [Accessibility] Screen readers announce every token during streaming due to aria-live="polite"

question: Which Control UI chat live-region behavior should be adopted for streaming responses before closing this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent accessibility policy needs maintainer choice and live screen-reader proof because aria-live="off", aria-busy, and final-announcement behavior have different assistive-technology tradeoffs.

options.title: Adopt narrow streaming suppression
options.body: Land or replace the linked candidate with a scoped busy/streaming suppression fix plus NVDA or VoiceOver proof that the final response remains accessible.

options.title: Choose a different ARIA pattern
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify an aria-busy, separate status region, or final-announcement design and ask for a new implementation.

options.title: Keep current live streaming
options.body: Leave the transcript polite during streaming, accepting the screen-reader noise as intentional live progress feedback.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow streaming suppression
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked candidate with a scoped busy/streaming suppression fix plus NVDA or VoiceOver proof that the final response remains accessible.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest history across the Control UI chat files and is the best routing candidate for the accessibility/product tradeoff.
